sections.1:
Archlin is a specialty chemicals manufacturing organization headquartered in Georgia, USA, operating on SAP S/4HANA with a current Excel-based planning process. Archlin’s planning environment is challenged by poor inventory planning, significant manual effort in consolidating forecasts from multiple regions, and the absence of a centralized planning platform across North America and Europe. Demand planners currently spend substantial time preparing and reconciling forecast inputs, while manual Excel processes create delays in monthly planning cycles. Forecast accuracy is approximately 68%, and inventory levels are higher than target due to limited forecast visibility.

Archlin’s Phase 1 scope is focused on Demand Planning as part of the broader project objective to implement Kinaxis RapidResponse for Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Inventory Optimization. The Demand Planning capability for Archlin is expected to generate statistical baseline forecasts, support planner forecast overrides, track forecast history and changes, and support multiple forecast hierarchies. The solution is also expected to improve collaboration by allowing sales teams to provide forecast input, enabling approval workflows, and providing forecast comparison reports. Analytics capabilities will include measuring forecast accuracy, measuring forecast bias, tracking MAPE by product family, and delivering dashboard-based reporting.

The implementation for Archlin will require integration of core planning data, including Product Master, Customer Master, Sales Orders, Inventory Balances, Purchase Orders, and Production Orders. The required data refresh frequency is every 4 hours. Business users emphasized the need for collaborative forecasting and improved visibility across regions, while demand planners requested automated forecast generation with the ability to manually override forecasts when market conditions change. These requirements establish the foundation for a more responsive and transparent planning process for Archlin.

The success criteria for Archlin include forecast accuracy greater than 85%, inventory reduction greater than 15%, planning cycle reduction greater than 30%, improved planner productivity, and establishment of a single source of planning data. Leadership expects measurable improvements in forecast accuracy and inventory reduction within six months of go-live. The Phase 1 Demand Planning implementation is therefore intended to move Archlin from a manual, regionally fragmented planning process toward a centralized demand planning capability with stronger collaboration, improved forecast visibility, and measurable business outcomes.
